title: Open Apollo plug-in art recipes, version 2
description: One file per plug-in panel spec (data/plugin-recipes/<spec>.json). A recipe regenerates a sprite on the user's machine from their own UAD install. It holds only facts about UA's files (file names and SHA-256, resource ids, byte ranges, blob SHA-256) and our operations, never pixels or UA text. Sprite ids share one namespace across files; the loader rejects duplicates. oa-assets runs the recipes (`oa-assets plugins`); plugin-ui reads the resulting manifest. Changes from plugin-recipes-v1: a recipe is a pipeline (`build`) whose first step is a source; decode modes for premultiplied 32-bit BMP, RT_BITMAP DIBs, JPEG, SVG and CRC-tolerant PNG; ops for stacks of crops from several blobs, fader/slider/meter/layer filmstrips, padded crops, arbitrary-size resampling and compositing; statuses runtime and deferred; the output hash is over RGBA pixels, not PNG bytes.

tier.description: coverage tier of the spec: 0 pixel-identical .. 4 code-drawn panel

uses.description: every sprite id the spec draws, including ids defined in other files

blobs.description: blobs named by load steps ({"op": "load", "blob": key}), so a blob used many times is written once

pipeline.description: the first op is a source (load, canvas, sprite, line, stack, thumb-fader, slide, layers); the rest are steps on the current image

file.description: file name inside the Powered Plugins folder, matched ignoring case

sha256.description: file versions the recipes were made from; other versions are still tried, every blob is checked by its own hash

status.description: verified: built from the install and the RGBA hash equals the reference art's; fallback: built from the install, on purpose not identical to the reference art (LANCZOS 2x of the DLL's 1x art where the reference was LUNA/hand art, similar DLL art for live-captured sprites, SVG rasterized by resvg), output.rgba is the hash of our build; runtime: drawn by plugin-ui code (owner, kind); deferred: part of a code-drawn panel that is out of scope for now, so the spec is not ready and the console shows the generic panel; no-recipe: nothing in the install can make it

basis.description: why: exact, derived, equivalent, dll-composite, similar, scaled, synth, derived-svg, live, luna, ...

owner.description: runtime/deferred: who draws it, e.g. plugin-ui/chrome

kind.description: runtime/deferred: chrome, text, vector, similar, scaled, ...

rgba.description: SHA-256 over u32le width, u32le height and the RGBA8 rows with R,G,B zeroed where alpha is 0

res.description: PE resource TYPE/NAME/LANG (numeric ids in decimal)

carve.description: [file offset, length]; when the bytes there differ, the blob is searched for by length and hash

inflate.description: the bytes are a raw DEFLATE stream (a ZIP member's data) that must end exactly at the last byte and inflate to exactly size bytes, which are then decoded

dec.description: png: CRC/Adler errors tolerated, tEXt InterleaveX/InterleaveY (Softube MPACK) undone; png-raw: rows as stored; jpeg: baseline, libjpeg-turbo ISLOW output; bmp/dib: Pillow's BMP rules (32-bit BI_RGB ignores alpha); *-premultiplied: 32-bit BGRA with alpha kept and colour divided by it in float32, truncated (all-zero alpha = opaque); mpk1: Softube zlib BGRA; svg-zN: resvg 0.48.1 at N times the document size, no fonts

axisMotion.description: [base, span, dir]: position = base + round(t * span), t = v (dir 1), 1 - v (dir -1), 0 (dir 0); round() ties to even

oneOf.description: decode a blob: a key of the file's blobs table, or the blob spelled out inline

axis.description: parts pasted one after another without blending; default y

oneOf.description: JUCE 1.52 fader: travel = w - thumb.w (w >= h) or h - thumb.h; n = travel // k + 1 frames; frame i = track with thumb alpha-composited at off = round(i * travel / (n - 1)) (centred across)

clip.description: cut the thumb at its frame's right and bottom edge

oneOf.description: n frames of w x h; v = i / (n - 1); thumb alpha-composited at (max(x, 0), i * h + max(y, 0))
n frames of (max width) x (max frame height); frame k alpha-composites frame k of every layer (a 1-frame layer repeats)

box.description: [x, y, w, h]; outside the image is transparent

oneOf.description: Pillow 12.3.0 Image.resize: separable fixed-point convolution; RGBA is premultiplied around it

blend.description: over (default): Pillow alpha_composite; replace: Image.paste; mask: Image.paste with src as its own mask

oneOf.description: n frames; frame k shows the image cut at round(H * (1 - k/(n-1))) from the top (vertical) or round(W * k/(n-1)) from the left

source: a transparent w x h layer with Pillow ImageDraw.line([(x0,y0),(x1,y1)], fill=rgba, width) set (no blending): Bresenham for width 1, Pillow's wide-line quadrilateral and polygon fill (float32 edge arithmetic) for wider lines, nothing for width 0

Pillow Image.transform(size, AFFINE, matrix, BICUBIC) on the premultiplied image: output (x, y) samples the input at (a(x+.5)+b(y+.5)+c, d(x+.5)+e(y+.5)+f); outside the input is transparent; numbers parse to the exact doubles written
the image as n equal vertical frames; output frame i is an exact copy of input frame order[i]
alpha *= min(min(y, H-1-y)/px, 1) * min(min(x, W-1-x)/px, 1) in float64, truncated; colour unchanged
multiply: each colour channel c becomes (c * t + 127) // 255; alpha unchanged
Brainworx disabled-control tint: for alpha al > 0, each colour c with target t becomes min(255, round_half_even((c*al*(256-a) + t*a*256) / 65536)); alpha unchanged
JUCE load-time premultiply undone: alpha 255 keeps colour, alpha 0 clears it, else c = ((c*al + 127) >> 8) * 255 // al

kind.description: dll-string: a NUL-terminated string -> Text/<id>.txt; dll-string-table: count fixed-stride NUL-padded strings -> Text/<id>.json (compact JSON list)
